title: Medtronic Pump Error When Getting Data from the Pump
body:
I bought Pixel 9 running on Android 16 (BP2A.250605.031.A2) and wanted to move my AAPS to it (Medtronic 715, connected over OrangeLink Pro, AAPS 3.3.2.0). But AAPS does not properly maintain connection with the pump. 

At AAPS I see that it starts reading history data from pump but suddenly stops when at Page 1 of data reading. If I go to History at RileyLink Settings the last record is GetHistoryData there. Pump stays in idle after that and AAPS never connects to pump again.

comments.body: It seems that there was a TBR in pump's history that caused this error. 24 hours later AAPS started working properly again, probably when that TBR disappeared from pump's history.
